page: Google Cloud Platform a4x-highgpu-4g is an accelerator-optimized server instance belonging to the a4x family. It features an arm64 CPU architecture with 140 dedicated vCPUs and 884.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 6.31 GB of RAM per core.

The instance is equipped with four NVIDIA GB200 GPUs from the Blackwell family, providing a total of 744 GB of VRAM. For high-speed local data access, the server includes 12,885 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the integration of Blackwell-generation GPUs, massive VRAM, and substantial local NVMe storage, this instance represents a high-density hardware profile designed for resource-intensive workloads. It is engineered for large-scale artificial intelligence tasks, deep learning training, large language model inference, and complex data science pipelines that require high-throughput GPU acceleration and fast local storage.
